images.title: Tamanna's two chocolates
images.purpose: Put Tamanna's two chocolates in front of the student before any fraction is said: a small bar and a big bar made of identical blocks.
images.composition: A small 2 by 2 bar on the left and a big 3 by 3 bar on the right, sitting on one baseline, each with a plain caption.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Left: one small chocolate bar of exactly 4 identical blocks in 2 rows of 2. Each block is a rounded square (corner radius 12 px), 150 by 150 px, filled teal #0072B2 with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline, and the blocks are 10 px apart. The bar spans x 238 to 548 and y 310 to 620. Right: one big chocolate bar of exactly 9 identical blocks in 3 rows of 3. Every block is the same 150 by 150 px size as the blocks of the small bar, with the same outline and corner radius, filled amber #E69F00, 10 px apart. The bar spans x 748 to 1218 and y 150 to 620. The two bars stand on the same bottom line (y 620) with 200 px between them. In all there are 13 blocks, every one the same size, none shaded, none missing, none broken. Under the small bar, centred at x 393 and y 690, the caption Small chocolate; under the big bar, centred at x 983 and y 690, the caption Big chocolate, both in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (40 px). No fraction, no number and no other text anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: The two chocolates are different wholes, and their blocks are all the same size, so the blocks can be counted.
images.description: Two chocolate bars of equal blocks: a small bar of 4 blocks in 2 rows of 2 and a big bar of 9 blocks in 3 rows of 3.
images.context: Concept image for the hook, Tamanna's Two Chocolates. It follows the idea of the figure in your maths book (a 2 by 2 bar and a 3 by 3 bar, no fractions written) and gives no answer.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student count the blocks of each bar, but do not say any fraction or answer on this picture. The slip to watch: deciding at once that 1/3 must be less than 1/2 without looking at the sizes of the bars.

image_decisions.why: The two bars of equal blocks put the hook question, can 1/3 of one be more than 1/2 of the other, in front of the student without giving the answer.
